The union merge (:272-297, predicate :284-291) additionally collapses three distinct drop causes

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):

- semantic_reject: adversarial refuters agreed 2/2 (conf 0.90, 0.90): The patch adds metrics for tracking failures but still destroys the HTTP status and error class by returning early (line 84) and catching without ret

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
